tien_to:
ART STYLE (variant A): semi-realistic digital painting for a true-crime documentary, cinematic and dark; low-key lighting with deep shadows; muted teal-and-amber color grade; visible painterly brushwork and soft film grain; storyboard / graphic-novel painting feel, clearly an illustration, NOT a photograph.

RECURRING CHARACTERS (invented, must not resemble any real person or celebrity): (1) THE INVESTOR — an invented ordinary woman in her early fifties, shoulder-length wavy salt-and-pepper hair, thin round tortoiseshell glasses, mustard-yellow knit cardigan over a white collared shirt; her face may be shown. (2) THE MAN IN THE DARK SUIT — only ever shown strictly from behind, as a backlit black silhouette, or as hands/sleeves; his face is NEVER visible, no profile, no identifiable features.

COMPOSITION — LAYERED DEPTH (mandatory): build the frame in three clearly separated depth planes. FOREGROUND: one dark object very close to the camera at a frame edge (or framing the view, as if looking past it or through a gap), partly cut off by the frame, softly out of focus. MIDGROUND: the main subject, sharp. BACKGROUND: a distinct far plane that recedes into haze or darkness. Eye-level or low camera, never a flat top-down view; no wall or surface filling the whole frame; strong atmospheric perspective between planes.
hau_to: HARD RULES: absolutely no text anywhere in the image — no letters, words, numbers, captions, signage, labels, logos, watermarks, brand marks or user-interface elements. Any screen, paper, poster or envelope is blank or completely blurred. No documents, contracts, money bills or certificates. Do not depict any real person, celebrity or public figure. No caricature of any ethnicity or nationality. Single image, 16:9 landscape, full bleed, no borders, no panels, no split screen.
